## Consumption modes

**Monorepo source.** Use this repository checkout. Framework dependencies resolve from `engine` with exact engine package versions. Do not select a separate engine revision.

**crates.io.** Once registry readiness is true, select the published framework version. Cargo's normalized package manifests omit the Git location and resolve the same exact engine versions from crates.io. Git and registry sources must represent identical engine source and public behavior.

Accepted exact-source Stage 1 evidence (issue #27) passed the macOS headless lifecycle and native macOS Metal profiles on monorepo commit 354486e3d7f0318487ed8583377b37747db62c7a, recording AppKit handles, the default hardware Metal adapter, backend-accepted presentation, interaction contracts, and the external pbpaste clipboard handshake. That evidence applies to the pre-cut source and does not verify this AppShell declaration implementation candidate, which changes identity-bearing compatibility metadata; re-acceptance is pending, including native-job story-smoke. Blockers:
